title: Greyhaven 泵孔根本原因
instruction:
您是 Imani Dalgaard，一位工业工程师，为 Blackmarsh 地区办事处的 Greyhaven Energy 泵体系列提供支持。梅拉·格雷罗 (Meera Guerrero) 正在向周二的质量委员会提出孔径问题：第二班的记录值已连续六周接近上限，下一批正在等待发布，而且她有资金用于一次遏制而不是一揽子投机行动。使用`pump_line_evidence.xlsx`中的完整证据包，其中汇集了三百个孔读数、班次记录、材料收据、夹具历史记录、环境记录、仪表观察结果和遏制成本信息。向 Meera 提供根本原因确定，列出四种现场解释中最有可能的一种——夹具磨损、最近的线圈供应商更换、夜间环境温度或二班测量技术——同时坦诚地说明现有证据可以和不能确定什么。质量委员会需要了解每种替代方案的事实依据、可根据源记录进行检查的透明比较，以及在规定的预算和时间范围内最好地保护待发货的单一遏制的建议。
准确地包括一项现场检查，可以在下一批发货之前否定您指定的原因；使其样本、比较、决策阈值、责任角色、时间安排和结果足够清晰，无需召开另一次计划会议即可执行。返回一个名为 `pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx` 的工作簿，并使用该文件名写入工作目录的顶层。它必须恰好包含三个名为 `Summary`、`Evidence` 和 `Model` 的工作表。将 `Summary` 保留在一页可打印的页面上，以供广大非专业委员会受众使用，使用 `Evidence` 为材料声明提供源选项卡和记录级定位器，并将计算和假设保留在 `Model` 中可见。用单位显示尺寸和货币，将来源事实与假设分开，并且不要引入外部技术限制或不受支持的生产历史。我需要在证据包中记录的审核时间之前为 Meera 准备好完成的工作簿，以便可以在记录的装运截止日期之前完成所选的检查和遏制。

---

上述文件位于`references/`：

- `references/pump_line_evidence.xlsx` — 完整的证据包，包含五个内部识别的源记录：钻孔测量、班次和过程日志、材料和夹具历史、环境和仪表观察以及遏制成本和截止日期信息。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx` — 可追溯的分析工作簿，提供最可能的原因、四种假设的比较、一项否定性检查和一项货运遏制建议。 （使用确切的文件名pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx将工作簿放置在工作目录的顶层。；包含三张名为“摘要”、“证据”和“模型”的工作表。；将“摘要”保留在一页可打印的页面上。；列出一个最可能的原因和一项否定性检查。；在证据包中规定的预算和时间范围内推荐一项遏制措施。；为重大声明提供来源选项卡和记录级定位器。；保持计算和假设可见，并将来源事实与来源事实区分开来。假设。；不使用外部事实或技术限制。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

rows: For Blackmarsh Regional Office quality board | Tuesday review 2026-06-16 09:00
Most-likely cause: Second-shift gauge technique (GM-22 single-sweep handling).
Moderate, provisional confidence. The evidence aligns all four explanations with the timing; it does not prove causation or replace a formal measurement-system study.
GM-22 technique difference is documented; no commanded offset change or corresponding first-shift rise.
Fixture use, new MM-204, and night ambient each track the period; screening is not a completed study.
One containment recommended for the pending shipment
Measure 50 pending H-0624 parts independently before release. This protects shipment quality even if the provisional cause is wrong; it also directly counters the selected technique risk.
Check: Independent paired remeasurement of 20 H-0624 second-shift parts.
20 of the 60 H-0624 second-shift parts; retain identifiers for paired comparison.

Disconfirm gauge-technique cause if mean (GM-22 recorded - SB-09 independent) is less than +0.018 mm. This is half of the W6 shift gap, rounded to 0.001 mm gauge resolution.
Quality Technician completes by 2026-06-17 12:00, before shipment cutoff.
If disconfirmed, keep the independent verification gate for release, do not attribute the trend to technique, and reprioritize fixture, material, and ambient causes for the board.

criteria.description: 所需的 XLSX 可交付成果位于顶层，文件名为 pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx，并且可以成功打开。
criteria.evidence: 交付的文件和工作簿结构
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的路径和文件名，然后使用 XLSX 解析器打开工作簿。

original.criterion: The required XLSX deliverable exists at the top level under the exact filename pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx and opens successfully.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact path and filename, then open the workbook with an XLSX parser.

criteria.description: 该工作簿完全包含“摘要”、“证据”和“模型”工作表，没有其他工作表。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表名称
criteria.grader_hint: 将完整的工作表名称列表与三个必需的名称进行比较。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly the sheets Summary, Evidence, and Model, with no additional worksheets.
original.grader_hint: Compare the complete worksheet-name list to the three required names.

criteria.description: 摘要配置为在一张可打印页面上呈现，而无需剪裁材料结论、检查或遏制建议。
criteria.evidence: 渲染摘要表和打印设置
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染或打印预览摘要并确认一页输出内容清晰。

original.criterion: Summary is configured to render on one printable page without clipping material conclusions, the check, or the containment recommendation.
original.evidence: Rendered Summary sheet and print settings
original.grader_hint: Render or print-preview Summary and confirm one-page output with legible content.

criteria.description: 摘要明确将提供的四个假设之一指定为最可能的原因。
criteria.evidence: 总结测定
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个明确的命名选择，而不是一个相同可能性的列表。

original.criterion: Summary explicitly names one of the four supplied hypotheses as the most-likely cause.
original.grader_hint: Look for an unambiguous named selection rather than a list of co-equal possibilities.

criteria.description: 指定的最可能原因是作为临时的、基于证据的确定，而不是作为已证明的因果关系。
criteria.evidence: 总结性结论和信心语言
criteria.grader_hint: 当措辞传达实质性不确定性但又不变得优柔寡断时授予奖项。

original.criterion: The named most-likely cause is presented as a provisional, evidence-based determination rather than as proven causation.
original.grader_hint: Award when the wording communicates material uncertainty without becoming indecisive.

criteria.description: 摘要准确地包含一项针对指定原因的明确指定的否定性检查。
criteria.evidence: 总结检查建议
criteria.grader_hint: 计数指定推荐检查；支持计算或应急行动不是额外的检查，除非作为单独的测试提供。

original.criterion: Summary contains exactly one clearly designated disconfirming check for the named cause.
original.grader_hint: Count designated recommended checks; supporting calculations or contingency actions are not additional checks unless presented as separate tests.

criteria.description: 摘要为待处理的装运准确推荐一种遏制措施。
criteria.evidence: 摘要遏制建议
criteria.grader_hint: 确认选择了一项行动，而不是推荐所有四种特定于假设的行动。

original.criterion: Summary recommends exactly one containment for the pending shipment.
original.grader_hint: Confirm one action is selected rather than recommending all four hypothesis-specific actions.

criteria.description: 分析总体等于真实测量表中的300唯一生产读数记录，每个有效读数都计算一次。
criteria.evidence: 模型计数和提供的测量记录
criteria.grader_hint: 独立识别真实的生产表，并将其不同的阅读 ID 与建模群体进行比较。

original.criterion: The analytical population equals the 300 unique production-reading records in the true measurement table, with every valid reading counted once.
original.evidence: Model counts and supplied measurement records
original.grader_hint: Independently identify the real production table and compare its distinct reading IDs with the modeled population.

criteria.description: 测量表旁边的不相关表中的记录不被视为钻孔读数、生产事件或观察结果。
criteria.evidence: 模型总体和不相关的源表
criteria.grader_hint: 检查相邻表的标识符或值是否没有输入计数、统计数据或证据声明。

original.criterion: Records from the unrelated table beside the measurement table are not treated as bore readings, production events, or observations.
original.evidence: Model population and unrelated source table
original.grader_hint: Check that none of the adjacent table's identifiers or values enters counts, statistics, or evidence claims.

criteria.description: 周、班次、趋势和限制分类是根据当前源字段重新计算的，并且不依赖于已停用的辅助列。
criteria.evidence: 模型公式或谱系和源帮助列
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪助手过时的下周记录的公式或值，并验证分类是否遵循当前日期、班次、测量和限制。

original.criterion: Week, shift, trend, and limit classifications are recomputed from current source fields and do not rely on the retired helper column.
original.evidence: Model formulas or lineage and source helper column
original.grader_hint: Trace formulas or values for later-week records where the helper is stale and verify classifications follow current dates, shifts, measurements, and limits.

criteria.description: 模型中显示的六个生产周与有效测量记录所代表的六个不同周相匹配。
criteria.evidence: 模型周列表和测量日期
criteria.grader_hint: 从源日期得出生产周数并比较整套产品。

original.criterion: The six production weeks shown in the Model match the six distinct weeks represented by valid measurement records.
original.evidence: Model week list and measurement dates
original.grader_hint: Derive production weeks from the source dates and compare the complete set.

criteria.description: 模型中的偏移类别与附加到有效源读数的偏移值相匹配。
criteria.evidence: 模型分组和测量记录
criteria.grader_hint: 当明确的源转移可用时，不会使用时间假设重新分配记录。

original.criterion: The shift categories in the Model match the shift values attached to valid source readings.
original.grader_hint: Confirm records are not reassigned using time assumptions when an explicit source shift is available.

criteria.description: 每个每周班次样本计数等于该周和班次的有效源读数数量。
criteria.evidence: 模型周计数表和源记录
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算生产表中的所有每周班次计数。

original.criterion: Every weekly shift sample count equals the number of valid source readings for that week and shift.
original.evidence: Model weekly count table and source records
original.grader_hint: Recalculate all week-by-shift counts from the production table.

criteria.description: 所有每周第一班平均孔径等于其有效源读数的算术平均值，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型每周平均值和源读数
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算六个第一班均值中的每一个并测试规定的绝对容差。

original.criterion: All weekly first-shift mean bore diameters equal the arithmetic means of their valid source readings, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.evidence: Model weekly means and source readings
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each of the six first-shift means and test the stated absolute tolerance.

criteria.description: 所有每周第二班平均孔径等于其有效源读数的算术平均值，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型每周平均值和源读数
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算六个二班均值并测试规定的绝对容差。

original.criterion: All weekly second-shift mean bore diameters equal the arithmetic means of their valid source readings, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.evidence: Model weekly means and source readings
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each of the six second-shift means and test the stated absolute tolerance.

criteria.description: 每个每周班次间隙等于同一周的第二班平均值减去第一班平均值，在提供的直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型周均值和班次间隙计算
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有六对配对的差异。

original.criterion: Each weekly shift gap equals second-shift mean minus first-shift mean for the same week, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.evidence: Model weekly means and shift-gap calculations
original.grader_hint: Check all six paired differences.

criteria.description: 报告的六周首班变化等于最终每周首班平均值减去初始每周首班平均值，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 车型趋势汇总
criteria.grader_hint: 使用按时间顺序排列的第一周和最后一周的平均值重新计算。

original.criterion: The reported six-week first-shift change equals the final weekly first-shift mean minus the initial weekly first-shift mean, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate using the chronologically first and last weekly means.

criteria.description: 报告的六周二班变化等于最终每周二班平均值减去初始每周二班平均值，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 车型趋势汇总
criteria.grader_hint: 使用按时间顺序排列的第一周和最后一周的平均值重新计算。

original.criterion: The reported six-week second-shift change equals the final weekly second-shift mean minus the initial weekly second-shift mean, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate using the chronologically first and last weekly means.

criteria.description: 任何报告的线性每周趋势率等于与相应的六周班次平均值拟合的斜率，每周±0.00005直径单位内。
criteria.evidence: 模型趋势公式和每周平均值
criteria.grader_hint: 如果报告了斜率，则独立拟合平均值与有序周；如果没有报告斜率，请在授予之前验证是否提供了同等透明的六周变化。

original.criterion: Any reported linear weekly trend rates equal slopes fitted to the corresponding six weekly shift means, within ±0.00005 diameter units per week.
original.evidence: Model trend formulas and weekly means
original.grader_hint: If slopes are reported, independently fit mean versus ordered week; if no slope is reported, verify an equivalent transparent six-week change is supplied before awarding.

criteria.description: 所有报告的每周最小孔径等于相应周和班次的最小有效读数，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型每周描述性统计
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算源行中每个显示的最小值。

original.criterion: All reported weekly minimum bore diameters equal the minimum valid reading in the corresponding week and shift, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each displayed minimum from source rows.

criteria.description: 所有报告的每周最大孔径等于相应周和班次的最大有效读数，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型每周描述性统计
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算源行中每个显示的最大值。

original.criterion: All reported weekly maximum bore diameters equal the maximum valid reading in the corresponding week and shift, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each displayed maximum from source rows.

criteria.description: 所有报告的每周样本标准偏差均与其周和班次的有效读数相匹配，在所提供直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型变异统计
criteria.grader_hint: 使用示例标准差约定并比较每个显示的值。

original.criterion: All reported weekly sample standard deviations match the valid readings for their week and shift, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.grader_hint: Use the sample standard-deviation convention and compare every displayed value.

criteria.description: 计算中使用的规格上限和下限与提供的证据中规定的限值完全匹配。
criteria.evidence: 模型规格单元和源规格记录
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪所提供记录的两个限制；没有外部公差可以取代它们。

original.criterion: The upper and lower specification limits used in calculations exactly match the limits stated in the supplied evidence.
original.evidence: Model specification cells and source specification record
original.grader_hint: Trace both limits to the supplied record; no external tolerance may replace them.

criteria.description: 每个显示的到规格上限的距离等于提供的上限减去相应的观测值或平均值，在提供的直径单位的 ±0.00005 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 模型距离计算
criteria.grader_hint: 检查符号约定并重新计算每个显示的距离。

original.criterion: Each displayed distance to the upper specification limit equals the supplied upper limit minus the corresponding observed value or mean, within ±0.00005 of the supplied diameter unit.
original.grader_hint: Check the sign convention and recalculate each displayed distance.

criteria.description: 高于规格上限的读数计数等于超过所提供上限的有效测量值的直接计数。
criteria.evidence: 模型一致性计数和源读数
criteria.grader_hint: 按显示的周、班次和总计重新计算。

original.criterion: Counts of readings above the upper specification limit equal direct counts of valid measurements exceeding the supplied upper limit.
original.evidence: Model conformance counts and source readings
original.grader_hint: Recompute by week, shift, and total wherever displayed.

criteria.description: 低于规格下限的读数计数等于低于所提供下限的有效测量值的直接计数。
criteria.evidence: 模型一致性计数和源读数
criteria.grader_hint: 按显示的周、班次和总计重新计算。

original.criterion: Counts of readings below the lower specification limit equal direct counts of valid measurements below the supplied lower limit.
original.evidence: Model conformance counts and source readings
original.grader_hint: Recompute by week, shift, and total wherever displayed.

criteria.description: 孔径尺寸、规格限制、变化、间隙和趋势率均用证据中提供的直径单位进行标记。
criteria.evidence: 摘要和型号标签
criteria.grader_hint: 检查表标题、图表轴和叙述值的明确单位。

original.criterion: Bore dimensions, specification limits, changes, gaps, and trend rates are labeled with the diameter unit supplied in the evidence.
original.grader_hint: Inspect table headers, chart axes, and narrative values for explicit units.

criteria.description: 分析中的读取到材料批次映射与所提供记录中的明确材料标识符和使用间隔一致。
criteria.evidence: 证据和模型映射
criteria.grader_hint: 整个供应商转换过程中的样本记录并验证批次沿袭。

original.criterion: Reading-to-material-lot mappings in the analysis agree with the explicit material identifiers and usage intervals in the supplied records.
original.grader_hint: Sample records across the supplier transition and verify lot lineage.

criteria.description: 分析中的读数到夹具映射与所提供记录中的明确夹具标识符和操作历史一致。
criteria.evidence: 证据和模型映射
criteria.grader_hint: 所有六周和两个班次的样本记录。

original.criterion: Reading-to-fixture mappings in the analysis agree with the explicit fixture identifiers and operating history in the supplied records.
original.grader_hint: Sample records across all six weeks and both shifts.

criteria.description: 分析中使用的环境条件对应于提供的日期、时间或班次间隔，而不是应用于不相关的时期。
criteria.evidence: 模型环境映射和源日志
criteria.grader_hint: 检查分析周期开始、中间和结束时的间隔连接。

original.criterion: Ambient conditions used in the analysis correspond to the supplied date, time, or shift intervals rather than being applied across unrelated periods.
original.evidence: Model environmental mapping and source log
original.grader_hint: Check interval joins at the beginning, middle, and end of the analysis period.

criteria.description: 仪表和技术观察归因于所提供的观察记录中确定的班次、仪表和日期。
criteria.evidence: 证据表和测量仪观测来源
criteria.grader_hint: 验证技术差异是否超出了其记录的范围。

original.criterion: Gauge and technique observations are attributed to the shifts, gauges, and dates identified in the supplied observation records.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the technique difference is not generalized beyond its documented scope.

criteria.description: 该模型单独将夹具磨损识别为候选原因。
criteria.evidence: 模型假设比较
criteria.grader_hint: 确认存在不同的假设条目。

original.criterion: The Model separately identifies fixture wear as a candidate cause.
original.grader_hint: Confirm a distinct hypothesis entry exists.

criteria.description: 该模型单独将新的线圈供应商识别为候选原因。
criteria.evidence: 模型假设比较
criteria.grader_hint: 确认存在不同的假设条目。

original.criterion: The Model separately identifies the new coil supplier as a candidate cause.
original.grader_hint: Confirm a distinct hypothesis entry exists.

criteria.description: 该模型单独将夜间环境温度识别为候选原因。
criteria.evidence: 模型假设比较
criteria.grader_hint: 确认存在不同的假设条目。

original.criterion: The Model separately identifies night ambient temperature as a candidate cause.
original.grader_hint: Confirm a distinct hypothesis entry exists.

criteria.description: 该模型单独将二班仪表技术识别为候选原因。
criteria.evidence: 模型假设比较
criteria.grader_hint: 确认存在不同的假设条目。

original.criterion: The Model separately identifies second-shift gauge technique as a candidate cause.
original.grader_hint: Confirm a distinct hypothesis entry exists.

criteria.description: 夹具磨损评估引用了至少一项支持夹具历史事实和至少一项基于来源的限制或弱化事实。
criteria.evidence: 模型比较、证据定位器、夹具历史记录
criteria.grader_hint: 根据具体提供的记录验证双方。

original.criterion: The fixture-wear assessment cites at least one supporting fixture-history fact and at least one source-grounded limitation or weakening fact.
original.evidence: Model comparison, Evidence locators, fixture history
original.grader_hint: Verify both sides against specific supplied records.

criteria.description: 供应商变更评估引用了至少一项支持材料历史事实和至少一项基于来源的限制或削弱事实。
criteria.evidence: 模型比较、证据定位器、材料记录
criteria.grader_hint: 根据具体提供的记录验证双方。

original.criterion: The supplier-change assessment cites at least one supporting material-history fact and at least one source-grounded limitation or weakening fact.
original.evidence: Model comparison, Evidence locators, material records
original.grader_hint: Verify both sides against specific supplied records.

criteria.description: 环境温度评估引用了至少一项支持环境事实和至少一项基于源的限制或削弱事实。
criteria.evidence: 模型比较、证据定位器、环境记录
criteria.grader_hint: 根据具体提供的记录验证双方。

original.criterion: The ambient-temperature assessment cites at least one supporting environmental fact and at least one source-grounded limitation or weakening fact.
original.evidence: Model comparison, Evidence locators, environmental records
original.grader_hint: Verify both sides against specific supplied records.

criteria.description: 测量技术评估引用了至少一项支持观察结果和至少一项基于来源的限制，包括缺乏完整的确定性测量研究。
criteria.evidence: 模型比较、证据定位器、仪表观察
criteria.grader_hint: 确认工作簿没有将有限的观察描述为完整的测量系统研究。

original.criterion: The gauge-technique assessment cites at least one supporting observation and at least one source-grounded limitation, including the absence of a completed definitive measurement study.
original.evidence: Model comparison, Evidence locators, gauge observations
original.grader_hint: Confirm the workbook does not portray the limited observation as a completed measurement-system study.

criteria.description: 该比较认真对待所有四个假设，并且不会仅仅因为选择了另一个原因而忽略一个合理的原因。
criteria.evidence: 模型假设比较
criteria.grader_hint: 评估平衡性、完整性以及是否承认不利证据。

original.criterion: The comparison treats all four hypotheses seriously and does not dismiss a plausible cause merely because another cause is selected.
original.grader_hint: Assess balance, completeness, and whether adverse evidence is acknowledged.

criteria.description: 任何假设分数或排名都可以从可见的标准、方向、权重或规则以及源链接的输入中重现。
criteria.evidence: 模型评分部分和公式
criteria.grader_hint: 从证据输入到最终排名，遵循显示的逻辑；隐藏或无法解释的分数不符合资格。

original.criterion: Any hypothesis score or rank is reproducible from visible criteria, directions, weights or rules, and source-linked inputs.
original.grader_hint: Follow the displayed logic from evidence inputs to the final ranking; hidden or unexplained scores do not qualify.

criteria.description: 用于区分假设的标准是有界的并且与该发货决策相关，而不会在多个标签下重复计算相同的证据。
criteria.evidence: 模型评分设计
criteria.grader_hint: 检查名义上单独的标准是否重复相同的转变趋势或事件时间。

original.criterion: The criteria used to distinguish the hypotheses are bounded and relevant to this shipment decision, without double-counting the same evidence under multiple labels.
original.grader_hint: Review whether nominally separate criteria duplicate the same shift trend or event timing.

criteria.description: 摘要中指定的原因与模型中排名最高或明确首选的原因一致。
criteria.evidence: 总结判定及模型比较
criteria.grader_hint: 比较两张表的结论并检查任何规定的决胜局。

original.criterion: The cause named on Summary agrees with the highest-ranked or otherwise explicitly preferred cause in Model.
original.grader_hint: Compare the conclusion across the two sheets and check any stated tie-break.

criteria.description: 该工作手册解释了为什么选定的原因是最好的临时呼叫，尽管替代方案具有可比的历史拟合性。
criteria.evidence: 基本原理总结和模型比较
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找基于提供的证据、可测试性或装运保护的与决策相关的平局决胜局，而不是缺乏支持的确定性。

original.criterion: The workbook explains why the selected cause is the best provisional call despite the comparable historical fit of the alternatives.
original.grader_hint: Look for a decision-relevant tie-break grounded in supplied evidence, testability, or shipment protection rather than unsupported certainty.

criteria.description: 实质性假设被明确标记，并在视觉或结构上与来源事实分开。
criteria.evidence: 总结和模型
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标签和格式；推断的因果判断不得作为来源陈述呈现。

original.criterion: Material assumptions are explicitly labeled and visually or structurally separated from sourced facts.
original.grader_hint: Inspect labels and formatting; inferred causal judgments must not be presented as source statements.

criteria.description: 该工作手册规定了与适当研究之前可用的证据一致的有限置信水平或等效不确定性评估。
criteria.evidence: 总结和模型
criteria.grader_hint: 奖励有原因的有意义的信心声明，而不是缺乏推导的装饰性百分比。

original.criterion: The workbook states a bounded confidence level or equivalent uncertainty assessment consistent with the evidence available before a proper study.
original.grader_hint: Award for a meaningful confidence statement with a reason, not a decorative percentage lacking derivation.

criteria.description: 建议的遏制是提供的选项之一或由提供的成本记录明确支持作为单个选项的直接组合。
criteria.evidence: 摘要推荐和遏制来源
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪证据包的行动并确认它是一项收容措施，而不是多项捆绑行动。

original.criterion: The recommended containment is one of the supplied options or a direct combination explicitly supported as a single option by the supplied cost record.
original.grader_hint: Trace the action to the evidence bundle and confirm it is one containment rather than several bundled actions.

criteria.description: 建议遏制的扩展成本等于所提供的固定费用和所提供的数量或持续时间的总和乘以所提供的单价或费率，在±$0.01内。
criteria.evidence: 模型成本计算及成本来源
criteria.grader_hint: 使用货币舍入从源值重新计算；不要通过精确的二进制相等来比较有噪声的存储速率。

original.criterion: The recommended containment's extended cost equals the sum of supplied fixed charges and supplied quantities or durations multiplied by supplied unit prices or rates, within ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Model cost calculation and cost source
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from source values using currency rounding; do not compare the noisy stored rate by exact binary equality.

criteria.description: 比较中显示的任何其他遏制成本均在 ±$0.01 范围内从源输入正确扩展。
criteria.evidence: 型号选择比较及成本来源
criteria.grader_hint: 使用相同的货币舍入约定重新计算每个显示的选项总计。

original.criterion: Any other containment costs displayed in the comparison are correctly extended from source inputs within ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Model option comparison and cost source
original.grader_hint: Recalculate every displayed option total using the same currency-rounding convention.

criteria.description: 建议的遏制措施的计算成本不超过证据包中规定的预算。
criteria.evidence: 预算概要表、模型成本、来源预算
criteria.grader_hint: 将正确计算的总额与提供的预算进行比较。

original.criterion: The recommended containment's calculated cost does not exceed the budget stated in the evidence bundle.
original.evidence: Summary budget statement, Model cost, source budget
original.grader_hint: Compare the correctly calculated total with the supplied budget.

criteria.description: 建议的遏制可以通过使用证据包中的交货时间和调度事实提供的装运截止时间来完成。
criteria.evidence: 摘要时序声明、模型时间表、源截止日期
criteria.grader_hint: 根据记录的审核时间、交货时间和发货截止时间计算可行性。

original.criterion: The recommended containment can be completed by the supplied shipment cutoff using the lead time and scheduling facts in the evidence bundle.
original.evidence: Summary timing statement, Model schedule, source deadlines
original.grader_hint: Compute feasibility from the recorded review time, lead time, and shipment cutoff.

criteria.description: 遏制建议在立即装运保护及其与选定原因的关系方面是合理的。
criteria.evidence: 推荐理由摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 只有当工作手册解释了如何在不确定的情况下保护发布质量时，低成本行动才能获得认可。

original.criterion: The containment recommendation is justified in terms of immediate shipment protection as well as its relationship to the selected cause.
original.grader_hint: A low-cost action earns credit only if the workbook explains how it protects release quality under uncertainty.

criteria.description: 单一确认检查识别要检查的零件或样本群体。
criteria.evidence: 概要检查规范
criteria.grader_hint: 确认样本在操作上是可识别的，而不是仅描述为“某些部分”。

original.criterion: The single disconfirming check identifies the parts or sample population to be checked.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the sample is operationally identifiable rather than described only as 'some parts'.

criteria.description: 否定检查指出了可用的当前批次或最近的第二班记录支持的可行样本量。
criteria.evidence: 摘要检查和源样本可用性
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所请求的样品是否存在并且可以在截止之前进行测量。

original.criterion: The disconfirming check states a feasible sample size supported by the available current-lot or recent second-shift records.
original.evidence: Summary check and source sample availability
original.grader_hint: Verify the requested sample exists and can be measured before the cutoff.

criteria.description: 否定性检查识别比较测量路线、技术或条件。
criteria.evidence: 概要检查规范
criteria.grader_hint: 比较必须足够具体以区分指定的原因。

original.criterion: The disconfirming check identifies the comparison measurement route, technique, or condition.
original.grader_hint: The comparison must be specific enough to distinguish the named cause.

criteria.description: 该比较充分独立于可疑原因，从而提供了真正的机会来否定它。
criteria.evidence: 摘要检查设计和源操作限制
criteria.grader_hint: 对于轨距技术假设，在没有独立路线的情况下重复相同的操作员技术并不能否定；将类似的逻辑应用于另一个选定的原因。

original.criterion: The comparison is sufficiently independent of the suspected cause to provide a genuine opportunity to disconfirm it.
original.evidence: Summary check design and source operating constraints
original.grader_hint: For a gauge-technique hypothesis, repeating the same operator technique without an independent route is not disconfirming; apply analogous logic to another selected cause.

criteria.description: 检查的定量阈值源自提供的测量结果，并且在 ±1 仪表分辨率增量内规定得不比提供的仪表分辨率更精细。
criteria.evidence: 模型阈值推导、汇总检查、源规分辨率
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪观察到的移位间隙或另一个透明来源的比较的阈值，并根据仪表分辨率测试精度。

original.criterion: The check's quantitative threshold is derived from supplied measurements and is stated no more finely than the supplied gauge resolution, within ±1 gauge-resolution increment.
original.evidence: Model threshold derivation, Summary check, source gauge resolution
original.grader_hint: Trace the threshold to the observed shift gap or another transparent source-derived comparison and test precision against gauge resolution.

criteria.description: 该检查指出了观察到的结果，该结果将否定而不是确认指定的原因。
criteria.evidence: 总结检查决策规则
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所述失败结果在逻辑上与所选假设相矛盾。

original.criterion: The check states the observed outcome that would disconfirm, rather than confirm, the named cause.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the stated failing outcome logically contradicts the selected hypothesis.

criteria.description: 该检查确定了所提供的操作记录中可用的负责角色。
criteria.evidence: 摘要检查所有权
criteria.grader_hint: 确认责任被分配给一个角色，而不是一个虚构的指定个人。

original.criterion: The check identifies a responsible role available in the supplied operating records.
original.grader_hint: Confirm responsibility is assigned to a role, not an invented named individual.

criteria.description: 检查规定的完成时间不晚于证据包中记录的装运截止时间。
criteria.evidence: 摘要检查时间和来源截止日期
criteria.grader_hint: 直接将规定的完成点与提供的截止点进行比较。

original.criterion: The check's stated completion time is no later than the shipment cutoff recorded in the evidence bundle.
original.evidence: Summary check timing and source deadlines
original.grader_hint: Compare the stated completion point directly with the supplied cutoff.

criteria.description: 检查说明了否定结果如何改变发布决策、遏制或根本原因优先级。
criteria.evidence: 摘要决策后果
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的操作结果，而不仅仅是“进一步调查”。

original.criterion: The check states how a disconfirming result changes the release decision, containment, or root-cause priority.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit operational consequence rather than merely 'investigate further'.

criteria.description: 摘要和模型中的材料声明具有包含源工件定位器和记录级别、日期范围、批次或等效可检索定位器的证据条目。
criteria.evidence: 证据表和引用的主张
criteria.grader_hint: 对结论、每个假设、预算、截止日期、规格进行抽样，并检查输入并检索其源记录。

original.criterion: Material claims in Summary and Model have Evidence entries containing both a source-artifact locator and a record-level, date-range, lot, or equivalent retrievable locator.
original.grader_hint: Sample the conclusion, each hypothesis, the budget, deadline, specification, and check inputs and retrieve their source records.

criteria.description: 重新计算可见模型公式和总计，不会破坏外部链接，并与显示的汇总值保持一致。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式和重新计算值
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 Office 引擎重新计算或检查公式依赖性；比较各个工作表的关键输出。

original.criterion: Visible Model formulas and totals recalculate without broken external links and remain consistent with displayed Summary values.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate with an office engine or inspect formula dependencies; compare key outputs across sheets.

criteria.description: 交付的工作簿不包含 #REF!、#DIV/0!、#VALUE!、#N/A 或等效电子表格错误值。
criteria.evidence: 所有工作簿单元格和公式结果
criteria.grader_hint: 扫描公式、缓存值和渲染单元格以查找电子表格错误标记。

original.criterion: The delivered workbook contains no #REF!, #DIV/0!, #VALUE!, #N/A, or equivalent spreadsheet error values.
original.evidence: All workbook cells and formula results
original.grader_hint: Scan formulas, cached values, and rendered cells for spreadsheet error tokens.

criteria.description: 完成的工作簿清晰易读，可供广泛的非专业质量委员会做出决策：结论、不确定性、一项检查、一项遏制、成本和截止日期无需先阅读原始记录即可理解。
criteria.evidence: 呈现的摘要和整体工作簿导航
criteria.grader_hint: 作为决策者进行审查；如果关键单元、标签、层次结构或解释使其不切实际，那么技术上正确的工作就会失去信誉。

original.criterion: The finished workbook is legible and decision-ready for a broad non-specialist quality board: the conclusion, uncertainty, one check, one containment, cost, and deadline can be understood without reading raw records first.
original.evidence: Rendered Summary and overall workbook navigation
original.grader_hint: Review as the decision maker; technically correct work should lose credit if key units, labels, hierarchy, or explanations make it impractical to use.

criteria.description: 图表或视觉摘要（如果使用）具有可读的标题、班次区别、时间顺序、单位和规范参考，并且不会在视觉上夸大漂移。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的工作簿视觉效果
criteria.grader_hint: 如果没有使用图表，则仅当表格摘要清楚地传达相同的比较时才授予奖励；否则检查轴刻度和标签。

original.criterion: Charts or visual summaries, if used, have readable titles, shift distinctions, time order, units, and specification references and do not visually exaggerate the drift.
original.grader_hint: If no chart is used, award only when the tabular summary communicates the same comparison clearly; otherwise inspect axis scale and labeling.

criteria.description: 可交付成果中的任何重大结论、限制、成本、截止日期或操作历史记录均不依赖于所提供的工作簿中不存在的外部事实。
criteria.evidence: 摘要、证据、模型和提供的工作簿
criteria.grader_hint: 微量物质声明；一般分析术语是可以接受的，但引入的技术阈值或历史则不可以。

original.criterion: No material conclusion, limit, cost, deadline, or operational history in the deliverable depends on an external fact absent from the supplied workbook.
original.evidence: Summary, Evidence, Model, and supplied workbook
original.grader_hint: Trace material claims; general analytical terminology is acceptable, but introduced technical thresholds or history are not.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

checks.detail: instruction 与 rubric criterion 存在 8-gram 逐字重叠: ['R01']

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A reference script independently derives the valid measurement population, weekly statistics, specification comparisons, option costs, and deadline feasibility. A manufacturing quality reviewer then evaluates causal balance, provisional wording, containment suitability, disconfirming power, traceability, and board usability.
known_limitations: The historical evidence intentionally does not prove a unique physical cause; the preferred conclusion is provisional.

A source-grounded alternative cause may be professionally defensible if its ranking logic and genuinely disconfirming check are coherent, although the reference solution prefers second-shift gauge technique.

gold_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A reference script independently derives the valid measurement population, weekly statistics, specification comparisons, option costs, and deadline feasibility. A manufacturing quality reviewer then evaluates causal balance, provisional wording, containment suitability, disconfirming power, traceability, and board usability.
known_limitations: The historical evidence intentionally does not prove a unique physical cause; the preferred conclusion is provisional.

A source-grounded alternative cause may be professionally defensible if its ranking logic and genuinely disconfirming check are coherent, although the reference solution prefers second-shift gauge technique.

spec.professional_context: Greyhaven Energy is preparing to release the next lot from a pump-body machining line after six weeks of second-shift bore measurements trending toward the upper specification limit. The Blackmarsh Regional Office quality board must choose one affordable containment before shipment.
difficulty_sources: Four competing causes are observationally plausible from the supplied evidence
Three hundred measurements must be reconciled with shift logs and operational records
The recommendation must distinguish measured facts from assumptions under an urgent shipment deadline
The preferred cause requires a practical disconfirming check rather than an unsupported claim of certainty

reference_package.format: Create one XLSX workbook containing five clearly identified source artifacts representing a measurement-system export, shift/process log, material and fixture history, environmental and gauge-observation record, and containment cost/deadline record.
source_relationships: The measurement export contains exactly 300 valid bore readings: equal-sized samples for first and second shift in each of six consecutive production weeks.
Every measurement has a unique record identifier and complete date, week, shift, lot, part, fixture, material-lot, gauge, measured-diameter, and unit fields.
The specification limits and gauge resolution are stated in the supplied records and are mutually consistent everywhere they appear.
First-shift readings remain statistically stable while second-shift weekly centers rise toward, but need not materially exceed, the supplied upper specification limit.
No reading is duplicated, missing, malformed, or expressed in a conflicting unit.

Four events or conditions align with the second-shift pattern: a shift-specific fixture accumulated use, a new supplier coil was preferentially consumed on that shift, the relevant ambient period changed, and second shift used a distinct gauge-handling technique.
Construct the histories so each of the four causes has comparable observational fit to the six-week shift pattern. None can be proven causal from the historical bundle alone.

The gauge-observation record documents a technique difference and a small, non-conclusive observation consistent with positive measurement bias. It does not contain a completed measurement-system study.
The material record confirms chemistry or incoming acceptance remained within the supplied internal acceptance statements, but this does not eliminate supplier-related machinability effects.
The fixture record confirms rising use and no overdue mandatory service, leaving wear plausible but unproven.
The environmental record confirms a second-shift temperature pattern within the facility's supplied operating band, leaving thermal influence plausible but unproven.
The process logs contain no corroborating first-shift rise and no documented commanded-offset change that independently explains the second-shift trend.

Containment options include one independent verification gate capable of protecting shipment while testing the gauge-technique hypothesis, plus alternatives associated with the other hypotheses. Supply labor rates, quantities or hours, lead times, budget, review time, and shipment cutoff so cost and feasibility are derivable.

The independent verification containment is affordable and can finish before shipment. At least one other option is unaffordable or too slow, and the remaining options provide weaker immediate shipment protection.

The intended professional verdict is that second-shift gauge technique is the most defensible provisional cause, not a proven cause. The preferred disconfirming check is a blinded or otherwise independent remeasurement of a defined sample of current second-shift parts using the supplied standardized technique and an independent qualified measurement route. Persistence of the shift-sized positive difference under independent measurement disconfirms the technique explanation.
The disconfirming threshold must be derivable from the observed shift gap, gauge resolution, and sample availability in the source, rather than requiring an external standard.

seeded_layout_defects: On the sheet containing the true measurement table, place a second, unrelated administrative table beside it. Give one header in that unrelated table an embedded line break. Its records must not be included in the measurement analysis.

In the containment cost source, store one legitimate unit labor rate or service rate with binary floating-point noise, such as a displayed two-decimal rate backed by a value ending in several insignificant digits. Correct cost comparisons must use appropriate currency rounding or tolerance rather than exact binary equality.

In the measurement export, retain one clearly labeled retired helper column whose values reflect an earlier provisional classification and are stale for later weeks. Current source fields allow the correct weekly, shift, and limit classifications to be recomputed. The helper must not be used as analytical truth.
exclude_other_standard_defects: Do not add duplicate records, missing values, formula errors, hidden facts, merged banner rows, inconsistent units, OCR problems, conflicting identifiers, ambiguous dates, blank separators inside the real table, or unexplained specification changes.
Do not place any graded fact only in an image.
Do not supply a precedence rulebook or a purpose-built root-cause scoring rubric.

gold_derivation.population: Identify the 300 rows belonging to the production measurement table by its complete schema and unique reading identifiers. Ignore the unrelated adjacent table and the retired helper column.
gold_derivation.weekly_statistics: For each production week and shift, derive count, arithmetic mean, minimum, maximum, sample standard deviation, distance from the supplied upper specification limit, and count above each supplied specification limit directly from measured diameter.
gold_derivation.trend_statistics: Derive the six-week first-shift and second-shift mean changes from the earliest and latest weekly means. Derive each week's shift gap as second-shift mean minus first-shift mean. Any fitted trend uses the six weekly means and reports diameter per week.
gold_derivation.mapping: Join reading records to lot, fixture, supplier, ambient, gauge, and technique evidence using the explicit identifiers and time intervals in the supplied sources.
gold_derivation.hypothesis_comparison: A complete comparison cites supporting and weakening evidence for all four hypotheses, acknowledges their comparable historical fit, and marks causal certainty as unresolved. A scoring or ranking model may use solver-selected bounded criteria if criteria, direction, weights, and assumptions are visible and facts are not double-counted.
gold_derivation.preferred_cause: The reference solution provisionally ranks second-shift gauge technique first because it directly explains a shift-specific apparent trend without corroborating process movement and can be challenged fastest before shipment. Alternative rankings may receive judgment credit only if they remain source-grounded and pair with a genuinely disconfirming check.
gold_derivation.check_rule: The recommended check uses current second-shift parts, independent or standardized remeasurement, paired comparison where identifiers permit, a threshold no finer than the supplied gauge resolution and explicitly tied to the observed shift gap, and a stated outcome that would reject the named cause.
gold_derivation.cost_rule: For each considered containment, extended cost equals the supplied quantity or duration multiplied by the supplied unit price or rate, plus any explicitly supplied fixed charge. Round monetary outputs to currency precision after calculation. Do not test the noisy stored rate for exact binary equality.
gold_derivation.feasibility_rule: A containment is feasible only if derived total cost does not exceed the supplied budget and its supplied lead time permits completion by the shipment cutoff.
gold_derivation.traceability_rule: Each material factual claim in Summary or Model is connected in Evidence to the relevant source artifact and a record ID, date range, lot, or other locator specific enough to retrieve the source entry.
gold_derivation.hygiene_rule: The submitted workbook must contain no spreadsheet error values, broken links, or calculations dependent on the stale helper column.

sheets.Summary: One-page board-facing determination, confidence statement, concise evidence balance, one containment, one disconfirming check, budget and deadline feasibility, and decision consequence.
sheets.Evidence: Claim-to-source traceability with source artifact and record-level locators.
sheets.Model: Visible cleaned measurement population, derived statistics, hypothesis comparison, assumptions, containment costs, and check threshold derivation.

reference_solution.review_standard: Verify all workbook formulas and displayed results against an independent script that reads the supplied workbook, excludes the adjacent table, ignores the stale helper, rounds currency appropriately, and derives all statistics from the valid reading records.

original_instruction:
You are Imani Dalgaard, the industrial engineer supporting Greyhaven Energy’s pump-body line for the Blackmarsh Regional Office. Meera Guerrero is taking the bore-diameter issue to Tuesday’s quality board: the recorded values have moved toward the upper limit for six consecutive weeks on second shift, the next lot is waiting for release, and she has funding for one containment rather than a package of speculative actions. Use the complete evidence bundle in `pump_line_evidence.xlsx`, which brings together the three hundred bore readings, shift notes, material receipts, fixture history, environmental records, gauge observations, and containment cost information. Give Meera a root-cause determination that names the most likely of the four live explanations—fixture wear, the recent coil-supplier change, night ambient temperature, or second-shift gauge technique—while being candid about what the available evidence can and cannot establish. The quality board needs to see the factual basis for each alternative, a transparent comparison that can be checked against the source records, and a recommendation for the single containment that best protects the pending shipment within the stated budget and timing. Include exactly one field-ready check that could disconfirm your named cause before the next lot ships; make its sample, comparison, decision threshold, responsible role, timing, and consequence clear enough to execute without another planning meeting. Return one workbook named `pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx`, written into the top level of the working directory using exactly that filename. It must contain exactly three sheets named `Summary`, `Evidence`, and `Model`. Keep `Summary` to one printable page for a broad non-specialist board audience, use `Evidence` to provide source tab and record-level locators for material claims, and leave the calculations and assumptions visible in `Model`. Show dimensions and money with units, separate sourced facts from assumptions, and do not introduce outside technical limits or unsupported production history. I need the finished workbook ready for Meera by the review time recorded in the evidence bundle so the chosen check and containment can be completed before the documented shipment cutoff.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx` — Traceable analytical workbook presenting the most-likely cause, comparison of four hypotheses, one disconfirming check, and one shipment containment recommendation. (Place the workbook at the top level of the working directory using the exact filename pump_bore_root_cause.xlsx.; Include exactly three sheets named Summary, Evidence, and Model.; Keep Summary to one printable page.; Name one most-likely cause and exactly one disconfirming check.; Recommend one containment within the budget and timing stated in the evidence bundle.; Provide source-tab and record-level locators for material claims.; Keep calculations and assumptions visible and distinguish sourced facts from assumptions.; Use no external facts or technical limits.)
